scope: Source comparison only: Being-H05 pinned commit 27ec67b84ac6c8e55f95408205e1ad7ba8bec253 vs current seven-task Pi05 continuation. No Being-H model was trained/evaluated on Wuji; no running training config was changed.

findings.pi05: 52 actual joint dimensions: left26 then right26; 6 arm+20 hand each
findings.being_h: 200 semantic unified slots, mapping and unused-dimension validity masks; default dexterous hand6+6 reserved slots per side does not directly fit Wuji20
findings.causal_status: No evidence of current 32-D truncation; larger nominal dimension is not proof of superior Wuji learning.

findings.pi05: 52 normalized values discretized into 256 bins and encoded as language tokens; max320 tokens, audited no truncation
findings.causal_status: Architectural difference; Pi05 design is official, not identified bug.

findings.pi05: Official flow MSE first averages 52 joints, then custom temporal padding mask and per-example temporal mean. No active-joint weights.
findings.being_h: Flow MSE masked over time and semantic dimensions; sum divided by valid-element count
findings.causal_status: Unused semantic slots differ from real inactive joints. Fingers represent40/52 coordinates, arms12/52. This is coordinate weighting, not measured error contribution. Active-arm error may be obscured by scalar average; requires controlled evidence.

findings.pi05: 52 absolute joint targets radians; common train-only quantile stats; half-range floor0.04rad; state clipped, action not clipped
findings.being_h: LIBERO example uses relative EEF actions+gripper with libero_nonorm, not absolute52 joint control; generic q99 transform clamps normalized values
findings.causal_status: Do not change semantics of old absolute checkpoint; new delta training needs recomputed statistics and matching inference inverse.

findings.pi05: 8 GPU full finetune, global32, constant1e-6, restore model and optimizer, total equivalent frame epochs10
findings.being_h: LIBERO example 4 GPU, full finetune, lr1e-4, cosine,60000 steps, resume_model_only True, token-packed batches
findings.causal_status: Example LR is100x current LR, but architectures/pretraining/batch/data differ. 60000 steps cannot be equated to our60k or epochs; no justified direct LR copy.

findings.pi05: single EGO, clean bilinear resize+pad224, horizon30, execute30 before replan, no RTC/MPG
findings.being_h: LIBERO example top+wrist,224, color jitter, horizon16, MPG enabled, training-timeRTC disabled, inference prefix-overwrite enabled
findings.causal_status: Useful candidate controls, not established cause of five-task failures.

conclusion: No new confirmed training bug from this source comparison. Five failed tasks x10 at step37000 =0/50 does not establish architecture cause. Compare per-task/arm/finger physical-unit errors, matched-budget single-task control, and separately controlled action representation/replan/LR changes after preserving this baseline.

current_config.optimizer: v4 step17000 AdamW moments and counts restored; constant 1e-6 continuation
current_config.sampling: uniform task then uniform episode then uniform start frame; replacement
current_config.image_preprocessing: PIL bilinear resize+pad224; random crop, rotation and color jitter disabled; same clean image preprocessing as inference
